record.question: Outpatient medical record originates in out-patient department and in-patient medical record originates in:
record.explanation: Official final key: D — Central Admitting Office. MPSC notification 9 March 2026, Group B non-gazetted technical H&FW examination held 29 January–2 February 2026; key physical page 3, printed Q97. Source limitation: The likely answer depends on whether “originates” refers to admission processing (Central Admitting Office) or inpatient clinical record creation (Inpatient Department). The final key establishes the historical marking choice without removing that limitation.
